title: File:Sámi mythology shaman drum Samisk mytologi schamantrumma 002.png

Categories.value: PD Old|Symbol images that should use vector graphics|CC-PD-Mark|PD-old missing SDC copyright status|Die lappische Zaubertrommel, eine ethnologische Monographie (1938)

ImageDescription.value: Sketch of a sami shaman drum with forked pointer and hammer. From Henric Forbus' En kortt beskriftning om Kongl. Missions Collegio i Dannemark, om Missionen, Lap Scholarne, och Lapparnes fasliga afguderi. Copenhagen, 1727. Pointer and hammer unfortunately removed during cleanup.

Credit.value: Samidrum (Ernst Manker: Die lappische Zaubertrommel, 1938, p. 353)

Artist.value: Ernst Manker. Scanning, cleaning up minor imperfections in the reproduction and removing the numbers was made by Tor Gjerde at old.no; Christopher Forster made the PNG images white background transparent using ImageMagick on GNU/Linux.
